workloads.name: dllm_concurrency_sweep
workloads._comment: One workload, swept over four concurrencies. NOT three shapes. Under the `custom` dataset loader INPUT LENGTH IS NOT A FLAG -- it is whatever the bank's text tokenizes to -- so a prefill-heavy variant would mean shipping a SECOND bank at a higher shot count rather than changing a flag. Concurrency, by contrast, IS a flag, and on this model it is where the headroom is. One bank, one shape, four concurrencies, one server boot for all four. NOT named `high_load`, and that is forced rather than chosen: `high_load` carries a contract that its profiles are EXACTLY c16/c32/c64, and this sweep adds c1. The escape hatch for a different shape is a distinct workload name -- mtp_longctx_8k does the same -- which makes that check skip this task instead of being widened for everyone. The metric follows the name, so _paired_helper.PRIMARY_METRIC carries an explicit `dllm_concurrency_sweep -> request_throughput` entry.
